corrections.change: Directory/comparison role is Server / Blocker, not Spiker / All-Rounder. Existing tier-list scores are not regraded.
Remove claim about additional airborne actions; retain Dash repositioning only. Historical and later balance accounts differ.
Retain charged airborne spike; omit specific mastery/knockdown dependencies.
Former names searchable; stable existing slugs preserved.
Server filter also includes documented serving specialists/hybrids Okazu, Kyamo, Timeskip Kyamo, Timeskip Okazu, Twins and Jinko. Role fit is not an official strength rating.

retainedLimitations: Older entries still carry July playstyle dates; no fresh verification timestamp is invented.
Existing comparison scores remain explicitly historical and are not regenerated.
New entries have null tier, scores and guide URL; no placeholder guide links.
Recorded return windows are historical records, not a live available-now assertion.

Local forwarded Discord export contained no official messages; it was not treated as proof of no updates. User-supplied Update 92–95 official announcements remain the primary evidence for those updates.
